component-o.description-s: MAX96717 CSI-2 to GMSL2 Serializer, 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 D-PHY input, single GMSL2 serial link output at 3Gbps or 6Gbps forward / 187.5Mbps reverse, coax or STP, 32-pin TQFN-SW

notes-as: 50 ohm single-ended (coax) or 100 ohm differential (STP) traces only; minimise length, no sharp bends
AC-coupling capacitors within 500 mil (12.7 mm) of the SIOx pins; component pads directly on the trace (no stubs)
ground cutouts under the high-speed pads, 1.3x the pad area; stitch ground layers with vias along the traces
PoC: smallest (highest-SRF) inductor on the signal trace, within 1/2 UI of the device; cutouts under the first two inductors and resistors
coax mode: terminate the unused SION leg with 100 nF in series with 50 ohm to ground (MAX96717 p22 pin 13)

source-o.pages-s: p42 (50 ohm coax or 100 ohm STP), p22 (SION coax-mode termination); trace rules as MAX96716A p67 (same GMSL2 PHY)

cfgpins-ao.3c: CFG0 sets main control-channel interface (I2C vs UART) latched at power-up. Typical application uses I2C mode with pull-down/pull-up divider to VDDIO per CFG0 Input Map (Table 11) row for I2C selection; typical app circuit shows a resistor divider from VDDIO to GND on this pin. Strap set from the datasheet's CFG0 input map, row I2C/RoR/0x80: R1 OPEN, R2 10k.

cfgpins-ao.4c: CFG1 sets GMSL2 link rate/coax-STP mode latched at power-up, per CFG1 Input Map (Table 12); typical app circuit shows a resistor divider from VDDIO to GND on this pin for 6Gbps coax tunnel mode selection. Strap set from the datasheet's CFG1 input map, row COAX/6/Tunnel: R1 32.4k, R2 68.1k.

cfgpins-ao.1c: Power-down input, active low, internal 1MΩ pulldown. Tie to VDDIO through the host GPIO/enable control; do not float. Hold low >= tHOLD_PWDNB (1ms) to reset.

cfgpins-ao.10c: Connect a single 402Ω ±1% resistor (RXRES) from XRES to ground per Table 3 External Component Requirements. Do not float.

cfgpins-ao.8c: Crystal input. Unused: CFG0 selects Reference over Reverse (Table 11 row I2C/RoR/0x80), so the serializer takes its reference from the link; leave X1/OSC open.

cfgpins-ao.9c: Crystal input. Unused with Reference over Reverse (see X1/OSC); leave X2 open.

cfgpins-ao.7c: Optional external 1.25V reference for the ADC. Leave open if not used (Table 1 pin description).

cfgpins-ao.12c: SIOP: GMSL2 link. CLINK 0.1uF AC-coupling capacitor in series between SIOP and the coax connector (Table 3); a series part to another component, not a pin passive.

cfgpins-ao.18c: MFP4 = RCLKOUT: 25 MHz reference clock out (divide by 2 or 4 available; or DPLL_OUT, 1 MHz up). Feeds an image sensor's EXTCLK (AR0235: 10-48 MHz), enabled by register.
